trap-superlative.evidence: 'All knots become topologically trivial under the symmetric quotient B_n ->> S_n.' The maximal quantifier is attached to the wrong object: knots do not become trivial - the INVARIANT stops distinguishing them, because the quotient forgets the braiding. The block's own preceding sentences say the right thing ('J_K(1) = 1 for every knot K', 'The Markov trace becomes constant'), so the over-claim is gratuitous.
trap-superlative.notes: STRUCTURAL (a meaning change, so not fixed inline). Proposed: 'All knots become indistinguishable to the invariant under the symmetric quotient B_n ->> S_n.' RIGOR (reported, not fixed): (1) CANONICAL MASS-FORMULA SHAPE. The block writes 'The topological mass formula m(K) = Vol(K)/hbar_q^2'. The canonical shape per AGENTS.md is m(K) = m_e . Vol(K) . rho(K) / hbar_q^2 - both the electron scale m_e (CAL-1) and the per-block density rho(K) are missing here. The divergence conclusion is unaffected (rho and m_e are hbar_q-independent), but the formula as printed is the purged short form. (2) UNSUPPORTED PHYSICS CLAIM: 'consistent with the classical expectation that only unknotted particles have finite mass' - no such classical expectation exists in the literature; this reads as a post-hoc rationalisation of the divergence. Proposed: delete the clause or cite what asserts it. (3) VERIFIED CORRECT: J_K(1) = 1 for every KNOT (the block correctly says knot - for an L-component link the value is (-2)^{L-1}); at q = 1 the Hecke quadratic has roots +-1 and H_n(R,q) -> k[S_n]; hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1} -> 0 and c_q = 1/(q-1) -> infinity; V^{(x)n} = (+) V_lambda (x) S_lambda keeps floor(n/2)+1 summands, consistent with the sibling proposition.
